audio_description:
From an Esthar gateway, the camera sweeps over the sprawling futuristic city.
It rushes along glowing magenta-and-green energy skyways between crystalline towers.
It passes through an industrial girdered transport bay.

context.scene_title: Esthar city — travel through the futuristic capital and its energy skyways (Disc 3).
locations: Esthar City — crystalline blue-green skyscrapers, hexagonal platforms, and the colored energy-tube transport roadways winding between the towers
context.summary: From an Esthar gateway the camera sweeps out over the sprawling futuristic city, then rushes along its glowing magenta-and-green energy skyways between towering crystalline structures, before passing through an industrial girdered transport bay.
context.context_note: High confidence: Esthar City and its energy-tube transit system.
